# ZAH KPO

> ZAH KPO (Zah Professional Services Private Limited) is an outsourcing partner for UK accountancy firms. Qualified accountants in Khargone, India prepare bookkeeping, year-end accounts, VAT returns, payroll, CIS, corporation tax and Self Assessment work inside the firm's own software. Every job is prepared, then reviewed by a second accountant, and tracked in ZAH Nexus, ZAH's own workflow platform where the UK team can log in. Founded 2025; founder-led by Husain Sangam (Chartered Accountant) and Mustafa Bag (B.Com, ACCA part-qualified).

Key facts:
- Who it serves: UK accountancy practices and bookkeeping firms (not businesses directly).
- Services: bookkeeping, year-end accounts (FRS 102 / FRS 105), management accounts, VAT returns (Making Tax Digital), payroll, CIS returns, corporation tax (CT600), personal tax / Self Assessment, MTD for Income Tax, iXBRL tagging, audit support, CFO advisory.
- Software: Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent, Dext, Hubdoc, Power BI.
- Pricing: flexible - pay per hour, a fixed price per job, or a dedicated team. No public price list; quotes on enquiry, usually after a short discovery call.
- Free trial: UK accounting firms new to ZAH KPO get their first three jobs free, any service.
- Quality: two-level review (preparer and independent reviewer) and founder review; service checklists; review points logged and closed in ZAH Nexus.
- Results published on the site: 5,000+ hours delivered for UK firms, 99% of jobs on time, 100% of VAT returns submitted on time and no penalties on returns prepared.
- UK GDPR: Article 28 data processing agreement, the ICO International Data Transfer Agreement or UK Addendum, a UK-to-India transfer risk assessment, sub-processor schedule and a Client Assurance Pack shared under NDA. Breach notice to the firm within 24 hours where practicable.
- Security: named accounts and MFA, encrypted company laptops only, USB storage blocked, Microsoft 365 with SPF/DKIM/DMARC and audit logs kept 180 days, client data never put into free AI tools.
- Contact: info@zahkpo.com; WhatsApp +44 784 842 6766 (messages only); India office +91 88899 84419. UK correspondence address: 5 Ruislip Road, Greenford, England, UB6 9QD. Delivery centre: GF 178, New Radhavallabh Market, Khargone, Madhya Pradesh 451001, India.
